label: EXPLORATORY until the M6 freeze
source: PRD v0.3 §14 'Automatic AT triggers' (HANDOFF R5: trigger rules v1 are fixed in advance from PRD §14). The list is the PRD's; the operational definitions are Claude's, written before any Arm D result was scored and approved by the owner on 2026-10-03 (P34; DR-0079, DR-0081).
appliesTo: Arm D. Each AT step of a journey, judged on the NVDA-absent leg's B2 evidence for that step (the DOM mutation timeline, the platform events and the accessibility tree), from the step's start to the end of its observation window.
stepTriggered: A step is triggered for an item when any trigger below fires on that step in any valid NVDA-absent attempt, on either side. Arm D then takes NVDA evidence for that step from the NVDA-present leg; it takes none for untriggered steps.
manualTriggers: A journey step's manualTriggers (owner overrides, HANDOFF §10.2) list trigger ids to force on for that step; none are set in v1.
excluded: PRD §14's last entry, 'other patterns demonstrated by the falsification spike to benefit from AT adjudication', is not in v1: it can only come from results.

triggers.fires: A timeline record inside a live region (inLive) or inserting a populated live region (liveWithContent), or a platform EVENT_OBJECT_LIVEREGIONCHANGED event.
A timeline record whose target or live root has role status, or a platform event whose object's ARIA role is status.
A platform EVENT_SYSTEM_ALERT event, a platform event whose object's ARIA role is alert, or a timeline record whose target or live root has role alert.

A platform EVENT_OBJECT_SHOW event whose object's role or ARIA role is dialog or alertdialog, a timeline insert or attribute record whose target has role dialog or alertdialog, or a dialog or alertdialog node in the step's end tree that was not in the previous AT step's end tree.
A timeline history record (pushState, replaceState or popstate) or title record, or a new document.

A timeline focusin record, or a platform EVENT_OBJECT_FOCUS event, in a step whose strategy does not itself move focus or the reading position (any strategy except TAB, SHIFT_TAB and the browse strategies NEXT_HEADING, NEXT_FORM_FIELD, NEXT_BUTTON, NEXT_LANDMARK, BROWSE_NEXT and READ_CURRENT).
The focused node in the step's end tree has an activedescendant property, or a timeline attribute record for aria-activedescendant.
